ui.title: Diet Management Agent
ui.tagline: A diet coach patients can talk to: it knows their targets, conditions, allergies and preferences, reviews their food log, and builds weekly meal plans through an attached workflow that checks calories, sodium, carbohydrates and allergens in code - every plan for a patient with a medical condition is approved by a dietitian before the patient sees it.

actions.label: Run: Weekly meal plan
actions.description: Run by the diet coach. Kaman drafts a week's meal plan from the patient's targets, conditions, allergies and preferences, checks calories, sodium, carbohydrate per meal and allergens in code, sends any plan for a patient with a medical condition - or one that fails a check - to a dietitian, and shares it with the patient once approved.

actions.label: Ask the Meal Plan Keeper
actions.description: Records a meal plan as a FHIR NutritionOrder and shares it with the patient.
